releaseNotes: Teacher app 1.13.10: fixes 'app keeps stopping' right after open. Cause: if the saved data file (school-data.json) got corrupted - by a crash mid-save or a full disk on an older version - the app crashed during startup on EVERY launch, before anything appeared on screen. 1.13.10 never lets a corrupt file crash the app: the bad file is kept safely as school-data-corrupt-*.json, the newest backup is restored if one exists, and the app always opens. It also now saves a rotating backup after every change, and the Support screen shows what happened if a recovery ever runs. Updates cleanly over 1.13.9 (same signature, no uninstall). Phones still on 1.13.7 or older: uninstall once, then install this APK. Console 2.2.24 unchanged.
